archetypes.name: dyn-ledger-history
archetypes.rationale: History-range and first-seen delta rules are the highest-risk logic.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the skill-closure ledger history walk and summary aggregation. Check that window and since-tag selections use the full predecessor sequence, first appearances never count as raises, and missing historical target rows remain lenient. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
